title: Superspace coinvariants and inverse systems for $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$
summary: Let $q$ be a prime power and write $Ω$ for the bigraded algebra of regular differential forms over $\mathbb{F}_q^n$. The general linear group $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$ acts on $Ω$; write $SI \subseteq Ω$ for the ideal generated by $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$-invariants with vanishing constant term. The {\em $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$-superspace coinvariant ring} is the quotient $SR := Ω/SI$. We calculate the bigraded Hilbert series of $SR$ and give an operator-theoretic characterization of the inverse system $SI^\perp$.
